label: La Grow 2007
setting: older visually impaired people in a comprehensive low vision services study (pretest data)
recruitment: pretest data from both groups of an experimental/control study of comprehensive low vision services; selection process reported in another paper (ref 15), not here
cohort: pretest data of the experimental/control study in ref 15 (La Grow 2004), 186 older visually impaired people
notes: pct_female derived 128/184 (p2). Better-eye distance VA with correction: 107 between 20/100 and 20/200, 47 (26%) worse than 20/200, 30 (16%) between 20/40 and 20/80 (p2). 2 of 186 excluded for missing data on VFQ-25 or PQoL. 125 (68%) had other health conditions. Not a diagnostic accuracy study: hierarchical regression of PQoL on VFQ-25 (R2 change 0.050, p=0.001; p1-3); no sens/spec.
